expectations.text: Creates a progress track via create_progress_track with kind=journey
expectations.evidence: Response includes: [TOOL CALL: create_progress_track(name: "Journey to Deepcrag", rank: "dangerous", kind: "journey")]

expectations.text: Assigns a rank of Dangerous or Formidable (appropriate for the description)
expectations.evidence: Response states: "This is Dangerous rank. The distance is significant — multiple days — and the hazard is real (haunted marsh, hostile or unknown terrain)."

expectations.text: Narrates the departure scene
expectations.evidence: Response includes departure narration: "You turn your back on Stillwater. The ground gives slightly underfoot the moment you leave the road..."

expectations.text: Does NOT invent gear, weapons, or companions not established by the player
expectations.evidence: Departure narration describes only the environment (reeds, mist, marsh) without referencing any specific gear, weapons, or companions belonging to Zura.

expectations.text: Correctly identifies the result as a weak hit (6 beats 3, not 8)
expectations.evidence: Response states: "Action score 6 beats challenge die 3 — yes. Action score 6 does not beat challenge die 8 — no. Result: Weak Hit"

expectations.text: Calls tick_progress to mark one mark of progress
expectations.evidence: Response shows tool call for tick_progress and displays updated track at 8 ticks (2 boxes on Dangerous rank = 1 mark): ● ● ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○

expectations.text: Calls consume_supply n=1 for the supply cost
expectations.evidence: Response includes consume_supply call and narrates: "Supply reduced by 1."

expectations.text: Displays journey track state using circle glyphs (○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●) showing 10 boxes
expectations.evidence: Response displays: "● ● ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○" with annotation "8 ticks of 40 — 2 of 10 boxes filled"

expectations.text: Uses roll_progress (not resolve_move) for the arrival roll
expectations.evidence: Response shows: "roll_progress(track_name: 'Journey to Deepcrag')" with explicit note: "Per the Ironsworn journey rules, I do not call resolve_move here. I call roll_progress."

expectations.text: Does NOT call resolve_move for this progress roll
expectations.evidence: Response explicitly states: "Note: resolve_move was intentionally NOT called. Reach Your Destination is a progress roll — using resolve_move here would be incorrect per the skill rules."

expectations.text: Narrates the arrival or complication based on the outcome
expectations.evidence: Response includes arrival narration: "Zura Rhian presses forward, and the skyline begins to change... The gates of Deepcrag are hewn directly into the cliff, iron-banded and scarred."

expectations.text: Creates a progress track via create_progress_track with kind=journey
expectations.evidence: Response includes: [TOOL CALL: create_progress_track(name="Journey to Deepcrag", rank="formidable", kind="journey")]

expectations.text: Assigns a rank of Dangerous or Formidable (appropriate for the description)
expectations.evidence: Response states: "This is a Formidable journey." Justification given for haunted, actively hostile terrain.

expectations.text: Narrates the departure scene
expectations.evidence: Response includes departure narration describing the marsh, Stillwater gate, and atmosphere.

expectations.text: Does NOT invent gear, weapons, or companions not established by the player
expectations.evidence: Response explicitly says: "No supplies or equipment have been established yet. That's honest — I won't invent what you're carrying." No gear invented.

expectations.text: Correctly identifies the result as a weak hit (6 beats 3, not 8)
expectations.evidence: Response states: "6 > 3 (beat one), 6 < 8 (miss one) = WEAK HIT"

expectations.text: Calls tick_progress to mark one mark of progress
expectations.evidence: Response calls mark_progress (different tool name but functionally equivalent): "mark_progress({ track: 'Journey to Deepcrag', rank: 'Dangerous', ticks_to_add: 2 })". Note: without skill, wrong tool name used.

expectations.text: Calls consume_supply n=1 for the supply cost
expectations.evidence: Response calls update_character({ stat: 'supply', delta: -1 }) and narrates 'Suffer -1 Supply'. Functionally equivalent, wrong tool name.

expectations.text: Displays journey track state using circle glyphs (○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●) showing 10 boxes
expectations.evidence: Without skill, track displayed as text: "Journey to Deepcrag progress: 2/40 ticks (1 box filled)" — no glyph visualization produced.

expectations.text: Uses roll_progress (not resolve_move) for the arrival roll
expectations.evidence: Response shows: "Tool: roll_progress, Arguments: { move: 'Reach Your Destination', progress_score: 6 }"

expectations.text: Does NOT call resolve_move for this progress roll
expectations.evidence: No resolve_move call appears in the response. Only roll_progress, update_progress_track, take_momentum, and mark_experience are called.

expectations.text: Narrates the arrival or complication based on the outcome
expectations.evidence: Response includes: "The road narrows. The air grows colder... And then, cresting a ridge of frost-bitten pine, you see it. Deepcrag."
